WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
),
shares AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       award_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();

assumptions.assumption: A blank hand is represented by an empty string, and missing (NULL) hands are grouped with it. Shares are fractions of all matched player_award records; the simple average is the unweighted mean of the hand-level shares.
